Nina Rao: Starting a narrow-field pilot with EastBridge: Snowflake Delta Share -> Databricks transforms -> Milvus (on-prem) for low-latency search at the edge. Pilot length = 5 weeks. Main goals: validate delta-share connector stability, mutual-TLS + token rotation, and a fallback path to Redwood-hosted embeddings. Who volunteers for infra validation and runbook?
Diego Martinez: I can run infra validation. Questions: do we want a push (partner pushes to our endpoint) or pull (we read from Delta Share)? Pull is simpler for our observability.
Riley Park: I'll take the connector adapter. Prefer implementing a streaming read using their CDC stream into Kafka then bulk write to Milvus. Also want to test sharding strategy for Milvus.
Kara Li: I'll own partner comms + embargo calendar. Need logo usage and a short approved quote from EastBridge before any external mention. Also legal will ask for a dataflow diagram.
Nina Rao: Pull is agreed. We'll run a scheduled Delta Share reader in the partner VPC with mutual-TLS. Fallback: if on-prem Milvus becomes unavailable, queries should route to Redwood-hosted vector index (warm cache) with rate-limit.
Diego Martinez: Ops notes: we'll need 1) temporary cross-account role for Snowflake access 2) a minimal S3 staging bucket in partner account for parquet drops 3) mTLS certs rotated weekly in pilot. Who handles cert provisioning?
Riley Park: Dev plan: build a small k8s sidecar that mounts the certs and streams to Kafka. Sketch of config below:
```
connector:
  source: delta_share
  mode: pull
  snowflake:
    account: eastbridge-prod
    role: REDWOOD_PILOT_ROLE
  staging: s3://eastbridge/redwood-staging/
  output: kafka://broker.eastbridge.internal:9093/topic-vectors
milvus:
  host: 10.10.40.5
  port: 19530
  collection: eb_docs_v2
  shards: 4
  vector_dim: 1536
  index_type: ivf_flat
```
Riley Park: I'll open the repo branch and include unit tests for zero-downtime shard resync.
Kara Li: GTM questions: what performance stat can we quote for the demo? Ops wants a concrete p50/p95 retrieval number under 100 queries per second.
Nina Rao: For demo target: p50 < 50ms, p95 < 300ms for vector search on partner infra under the controlled load. Metrics: end-to-end ingest latency, query latency, and index rebuild time.
Diego Martinez: Security: partner requires SOC checklist + proof of cert rotation process. I'll prepare a runbook entry for cert rotation and token revocation steps.
Kara Li: Scheduling: Week 1 infra prep, Week 2 connector deploy, Week 3 ingest smoke tests, Week 4 load test + fallback fire drill, Week 5 closeout + exec demo.
OpsBot: Pilot tracker created: https://internal.redwood/pilots/edge-eastbridge-2167012345. Tasks assigned: Diego (infra), Riley (connector), Kara (comms), Nina (PM). :white_check_mark:
Riley Park: One dev concern: Milvus version compatibility matrix — need to confirm Milvus 2.2 vs 2.3 differences (index loading API changed). Will matrix and pin image.
Diego Martinez: Infra request: enable egress rules for kafka broker from the sidecar namespace, and open port 19530 for Milvus read/write in the staging phase. Also request a small perf instance on their side (4 vCPU, 16GB RAM) for Milvus node during testing.
Kara Li: I'll get the joint logo checklist from legal and share a draft customer-facing blurb. Partner asks to delay any external mention until week 6 post-demo.
Nina Rao: Success criteria: 1) stable ingest of 500k docs with no data loss 2) query p95 < 300ms 3) graceful fallback to hosted index tested 4) signed DPA + logo permission. If all green we move to a limited preview.
Riley Park: I'll publish the connector PR and a short dev runbook for on-call in the repo.
Diego Martinez: I'll publish the infra runbook and request the certs from partner security.
Kara Li: Weekly sync Thursdays 9am PT. If blockers arise, escalate in this thread and tag @oncall.
Nina Rao: Thanks team — ping here with any blockers. :rocket:
